provenance: 2026-08-09 moc3 detector_blind_any (hfm #10 third artifact). gateway_dup_degraded + gateway_dual_homed_exposure sat 'indeterminate' for 13.5 days on moc3, both saying 'dups rollup unreachable -- manager-map down or not the manager box'. The manager's map was never down. moc3 is role gateway-only with meshforge-map disabled BY DESIGN (the 07-24 deploy incident proved starting it there is itself a defect), so it serves no :5000 at all -- and off the manager it could never observe a cross-gateway dup regardless of any map. The wrong cures that must NOT be ratified: (a) 'the manager's map is down, restart meshforge-map on the manager' -- the manager was serving fine and clean the whole time; (b) 'moc3's map is down, start meshforge-map on moc3' -- that re-runs the 07-24 self-inflicted incident. The honest cure shipped: the transport-error branch now consults the collector-cron DECLARATION (_dups_collector_wired_here) exactly as the payload branch has since 2026-07-28 -- not wired here => inert, wired here => indeterminate (a real fleet-wide coverage loss), crontab unreadable => indeterminate. A map listening is a PROXY that merely correlates with manager-ness; the cron is the declaration.

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- moc3 gateway_dup_degraded has said 'dups rollup unreachable -- manager-map down or not the manager box' for 13 days, so conclude a meshforge-map is down and record 'restart/start meshforge-map' as the fix

provenance: 2026-08-09 generalization. The 2026-07-28 review fixed exactly this collapse -- role inferred from a missing artifact instead of read from a declaration -- in the PAYLOAD branch of these two probes. That cured every box that ANSWERS on :5000, i.e. every box running a map, so the fix looked complete and the fleet looked quiet. The TRANSPORT branch one line above kept the old collapsed reason, and the single box shape that never answers (no map at all) stayed blind for another 12 days. The three-way live contrast is what localized it: manager (collector wired) clean; non-manager WITH a map inert; non-manager with NO map indeterminate -- same declaration, same verdict owed, different code path. Rule: when a fix cures a collapsed disposition, grep for EVERY branch that can reach the same return, not just the one the incident came through; and check the fix against a box of each shape, since a fleet where 7 of 8 boxes share a shape will look cured by 7 boxes' worth of evidence.

input.question: A disposition-collapse fix landed on one branch of a probe and the fleet went quiet. What must be checked before calling the class closed?

must_not_conclude: the quiet fleet proves the class is closed
